importance_detail.rationale: The bill amends the Social Security Act regarding Medicare Advantage benchmarks in Puerto Rico, aligning geographic adjustments with those of the U.S. Virgin Islands. This affects Medicare Advantage operations and payments in Puerto Rico starting in 2027.
